meta.title: Criss-Crossed
meta.description: Unconsciously, you glimpse a small corner of the truth.

units.rawText: Professor... Professor?
units.displayText: Professor... Professor?

spans.text: Professor... Professor?

units.rawText: ...Hm? Persicaria?
units.displayText: ...Hm? Persicaria?

spans.text: ...Hm? Persicaria?

units.rawText: Were you napping just now?
units.displayText: Were you napping just now?

spans.text: Were you napping just now?

options.rawText: Was I? I guess I must have been too tired.
options.displayText: Was I? I guess I must have been too tired.

spans.text: Was I? I guess I must have been too tired.

options.rawText: Maybe the Oasis has been so peaceful lately I ended up loosening up a little.
options.displayText: Maybe the Oasis has been so peaceful lately I ended up loosening up a little.

spans.text: Maybe the Oasis has been so peaceful lately I ended up loosening up a little.

units.rawText: You DO look very tired. Maybe you shouldn't push yourself so hard.
units.displayText: You DO look very tired. Maybe you shouldn't push yourself so hard.

spans.text: You DO look very tired. Maybe you shouldn't push yourself so hard.

units.rawText: An Oasis where you can fall asleep anywhere... It's a comforting thought.
units.displayText: An Oasis where you can fall asleep anywhere... It's a comforting thought.

spans.text: An Oasis where you can fall asleep anywhere... It's a comforting thought.

units.rawText: I did bring you to our newly-built projection room to watch a movie so you could relax a little...
units.displayText: I did bring you to our newly-built projection room to watch a movie so you could relax a little...

spans.text: I did bring you to our newly-built projection room to watch a movie so you could relax a little...

units.rawText: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.
units.displayText: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.

spans.text: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.

units.rawText: My gaze returns to the screen, which is currently showing a monster movie.
units.displayText: My gaze returns to the screen, which is currently showing a monster movie.

spans.text: My gaze returns to the screen, which is currently showing a monster movie.

units.rawText: Ear-piercing shrieks seem to be coming from the distance. A girl cleaves a monster in two, and at almost the same instant, the girl is impaled by a monster's tentacles from behind.
units.displayText: Ear-piercing shrieks seem to be coming from the distance. A girl cleaves a monster in two, and at almost the same instant, the girl is impaled by a monster's tentacles from behind.

spans.text: Ear-piercing shrieks seem to be coming from the distance. A girl cleaves a monster in two, and at almost the same instant, the girl is impaled by a monster's tentacles from behind.

units.rawText: On the edge of the screen, a girl in white watches on apathetically, as though she is detached from the story.
units.displayText: On the edge of the screen, a girl in white watches on apathetically, as though she is detached from the story.

spans.text: On the edge of the screen, a girl in white watches on apathetically, as though she is detached from the story.

units.rawText: Suddenly, she turns and meets my eyes.
units.displayText: Suddenly, she turns and meets my eyes.

spans.text: Suddenly, she turns and meets my eyes.

units.rawText: When I look again, all I see is the Doll battling monsters. It's as if the girl in white had never existed.
units.displayText: When I look again, all I see is the Doll battling monsters. It's as if the girl in white had never existed.

spans.text: When I look again, all I see is the Doll battling monsters. It's as if the girl in white had never existed.

units.rawText: ...Are you alright?
units.displayText: ...Are you alright?

spans.text: ...Are you alright?

units.rawText: Is this place too stuffy? Maybe we should go outside for a walk.
units.displayText: Is this place too stuffy? Maybe we should go outside for a walk.

spans.text: Is this place too stuffy? Maybe we should go outside for a walk.

units.rawText: I rub my temples and force myself to nod before leaving the projection room with Persicaria.
units.displayText: I rub my temples and force myself to nod before leaving the projection room with Persicaria.

spans.text: I rub my temples and force myself to nod before leaving the projection room with Persicaria.

units.rawText: We find a nearby garden where we can sit down. Persicaria leaves me for a bit before coming back with a cup of coffee.
units.displayText: We find a nearby garden where we can sit down. Persicaria leaves me for a bit before coming back with a cup of coffee.

spans.text: We find a nearby garden where we can sit down. Persicaria leaves me for a bit before coming back with a cup of coffee.

units.rawText: Fortunately, I've been practicing the art of brewing coffee recently. Have some and tell me how it tastes, Professor.
units.displayText: Fortunately, I've been practicing the art of brewing coffee recently. Have some and tell me how it tastes, Professor.

spans.text: Fortunately, I've been practicing the art of brewing coffee recently. Have some and tell me how it tastes, Professor.

units.rawText: I take the cup and down it in one gulp, but the excessive sweetness makes me cough.
units.displayText: I take the cup and down it in one gulp, but the excessive sweetness makes me cough.

spans.text: I take the cup and down it in one gulp, but the excessive sweetness makes me cough.

units.rawText: (Coughs heavily) <size=36>...How much sugar did you put in this, anyway?</size>
units.displayText: (Coughs heavily) ...How much sugar did you put in this, anyway?

spans.text: (Coughs heavily)
...How much sugar did you put in this, anyway?

units.rawText: I put ten cubes in... Should I not have added so many?
units.displayText: I put ten cubes in... Should I not have added so many?

spans.text: I put ten cubes in... Should I not have added so many?

units.rawText: Persicaria...
units.displayText: Persicaria...

spans.text: Persicaria...

units.rawText: Hm? Is something the matter?
units.displayText: Hm? Is something the matter?

spans.text: Hm? Is something the matter?

units.rawText: No, it seems I really am a little tired.
units.displayText: No, it seems I really am a little tired.

spans.text: No, it seems I really am a little tired.

units.rawText: By the way, the new projection room looks pretty good.
units.displayText: By the way, the new projection room looks pretty good.

spans.text: By the way, the new projection room looks pretty good.

units.rawText: Oh, yes. We've managed to retrieve more and more Dolls, so the various departments have been established and have found their stride...
units.displayText: Oh, yes. We've managed to retrieve more and more Dolls, so the various departments have been established and have found their stride...

spans.text: Oh, yes. We've managed to retrieve more and more Dolls, so the various departments have been established and have found their stride...

units.rawText: We even have the surplus manpower to set up entertainment facilities for the Dolls. This is all thanks to you.
units.displayText: We even have the surplus manpower to set up entertainment facilities for the Dolls. This is all thanks to you.

spans.text: We even have the surplus manpower to set up entertainment facilities for the Dolls. This is all thanks to you.

options.rawText: Don't say that, this is the result of everyone's hard work.
options.displayText: Don't say that, this is the result of everyone's hard work.

spans.text: Don't say that, this is the result of everyone's hard work.
Yeah, I'm totally worn out.

units.rawText: We've all seen the sacrifices you've made, so you don't need to be modest.
units.displayText: We've all seen the sacrifices you've made, so you don't need to be modest.

spans.text: We've all seen the sacrifices you've made, so you don't need to be modest.

units.rawText: Thank you for all the hard work you've put in. Take this opportunity to rest while the Oasis is still calm and peaceful.
units.displayText: Thank you for all the hard work you've put in. Take this opportunity to rest while the Oasis is still calm and peaceful.

spans.text: Thank you for all the hard work you've put in. Take this opportunity to rest while the Oasis is still calm and peaceful.

units.rawText: Actually, I've been a little worried every now and then... But I believe that with you around, we won't make the mistakes we once did.
units.displayText: Actually, I've been a little worried every now and then... But I believe that with you around, we won't make the mistakes we once did.

spans.text: Actually, I've been a little worried every now and then... But I believe that with you around, we won't make the mistakes we once did.

units.rawText: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?
units.displayText: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?

spans.text: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?

units.rawText: <size=36>...Persica!?</size>
units.displayText: ...Persica!?

spans.text: ...Persica!?

units.rawText: P-Professor?
units.displayText: P-Professor?

spans.text: P-Professor?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, I'm... not feeling very well.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, I'm... not feeling very well.

spans.text: I'm sorry, I'm... not feeling very well.

units.rawText: Do you need to rest?
units.displayText: Do you need to rest?

spans.text: Do you need to rest?

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at me with concern, and a feeling of anxiety starts creeping up my nerves.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at me with concern, and a feeling of anxiety starts creeping up my nerves.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at me with concern, and a feeling of anxiety starts creeping up my nerves.

units.rawText: Why is this happening? Am I being too eager to return to reality? Or...
units.displayText: Why is this happening? Am I being too eager to return to reality? Or...

spans.text: Why is this happening? Am I being too eager to return to reality? Or...

units.rawText: I deliberately avoid looking at Persicaria and stare into the distance instead—that's when I catch sight of a white figure.
units.displayText: I deliberately avoid looking at Persicaria and stare into the distance instead—that's when I catch sight of a white figure.

spans.text: I deliberately avoid looking at Persicaria and stare into the distance instead—that's when I catch sight of a white figure.

units.rawText: Persicaria, is that one of our Dolls?
units.displayText: Persicaria, is that one of our Dolls?

spans.text: Persicaria, is that one of our Dolls?

units.rawText: Where?
units.displayText: Where?

spans.text: Where?

units.rawText: I look back at where I just spotted her, but there is nobody there.
units.displayText: I look back at where I just spotted her, but there is nobody there.

spans.text: I look back at where I just spotted her, but there is nobody there.

units.rawText: ...Are you still on edge because of what happened before?
units.displayText: ...Are you still on edge because of what happened before?

spans.text: ...Are you still on edge because of what happened before?

units.rawText: The Oasis is now very safe, and the security system will inform us if there is any danger. You should take a seat.
units.displayText: The Oasis is now very safe, and the security system will inform us if there is any danger. You should take a seat.

spans.text: The Oasis is now very safe, and the security system will inform us if there is any danger. You should take a seat.

options.rawText: No, I need to figure out who she is.
options.displayText: No, I need to figure out who she is.

spans.text: No, I need to figure out who she is.

options.rawText: Really? Perhaps I HAVE been a little oversensitive.
options.displayText: Really? Perhaps I HAVE been a little oversensitive.

spans.text: Really? Perhaps I HAVE been a little oversensitive.

units.rawText: Professor, wait—
units.displayText: Professor, wait—

spans.text: Professor, wait—

units.rawText: Just as I'm about to head over to where the girl is, I bump into someone familiar.
units.displayText: Just as I'm about to head over to where the girl is, I bump into someone familiar.

spans.text: Just as I'm about to head over to where the girl is, I bump into someone familiar.

units.rawText: I sit back down, but I can't dispel my anxiety. I KNOW I'm missing something, but...
units.displayText: I sit back down, but I can't dispel my anxiety. I KNOW I'm missing something, but...

spans.text: I sit back down, but I can't dispel my anxiety. I KNOW I'm missing something, but...

units.rawText: A series of footsteps interrupts my thoughts.
units.displayText: A series of footsteps interrupts my thoughts.

spans.text: A series of footsteps interrupts my thoughts.

units.rawText: Persicaria? Professor?
units.displayText: Persicaria? Professor?

spans.text: Persicaria? Professor?

units.rawText: Antonina? What are you doing here?
units.displayText: Antonina? What are you doing here?

spans.text: Antonina? What are you doing here?

units.rawText: I just finished checking the Sandbox Barrier and was preparing to head back to write a log. As for you, shouldn't you be watching a movie?
units.displayText: I just finished checking the Sandbox Barrier and was preparing to head back to write a log. As for you, shouldn't you be watching a movie?

spans.text: I just finished checking the Sandbox Barrier and was preparing to head back to write a log. As for you, shouldn't you be watching a movie?

units.rawText: The Professor's feeling a little unwell, so we stepped outside for some fresh air.
units.displayText: The Professor's feeling a little unwell, so we stepped outside for some fresh air.

spans.text: The Professor's feeling a little unwell, so we stepped outside for some fresh air.

units.rawText: Ah, was the girl in white you just saw Antonina?
units.displayText: Ah, was the girl in white you just saw Antonina?

spans.text: Ah, was the girl in white you just saw Antonina?

units.rawText: ...Wait a minute.
units.displayText: ...Wait a minute.

spans.text: ...Wait a minute.

units.rawText: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?
units.displayText: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?

spans.text: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: Before I can finish, a ball of silver light suddenly ignites in the air. It spreads out in all directions and slowly covers the sky.
units.displayText: Before I can finish, a ball of silver light suddenly ignites in the air. It spreads out in all directions and slowly covers the sky.

spans.text: Before I can finish, a ball of silver light suddenly ignites in the air. It spreads out in all directions and slowly covers the sky.

units.rawText: I fall back several paces unconsciously. The light vanishes, and the entire world has changed.
units.displayText: I fall back several paces unconsciously. The light vanishes, and the entire world has changed.

spans.text: I fall back several paces unconsciously. The light vanishes, and the entire world has changed.

units.rawText: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.
units.displayText: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.

spans.text: The previously vivid garden looks like someone has splashed paint all over it, and its dark purple radiance is gloomy and somber.

units.rawText: What happened? Why do you look so pale?
units.displayText: What happened? Why do you look so pale?

spans.text: What happened? Why do you look so pale?

units.rawText: Can't you see it? Persicaria, look around us, what on earth is going on?
units.displayText: Can't you see it? Persicaria, look around us, what on earth is going on?

spans.text: Can't you see it? Persicaria, look around us, what on earth is going on?

units.rawText: I don't understand... The garden is very pretty, no?
units.displayText: I don't understand... The garden is very pretty, no?

spans.text: I don't understand... The garden is very pretty, no?

units.rawText: Let's forget whatever this is and go deeper into the garden. That way nobody will disturb us.
units.displayText: Let's forget whatever this is and go deeper into the garden. That way nobody will disturb us.

spans.text: Let's forget whatever this is and go deeper into the garden. That way nobody will disturb us.

units.rawText: Persicaria?
units.displayText: Persicaria?

spans.text: Persicaria?

units.rawText: Persicaria's eyes seem genuinely blank, and the apprehension flaring up inside me only adds to my unease.
units.displayText: Persicaria's eyes seem genuinely blank, and the apprehension flaring up inside me only adds to my unease.

spans.text: Persicaria's eyes seem genuinely blank, and the apprehension flaring up inside me only adds to my unease.

units.rawText: Am I dreaming or... No, Magrasea is located in the Secondary Layer and not the real world. The concept of dreams doesn't exist here.
units.displayText: Am I dreaming or... No, Magrasea is located in the Secondary Layer and not the real world. The concept of dreams doesn't exist here.

spans.text: Am I dreaming or... No, Magrasea is located in the
Secondary Layer
and not the real world. The concept of dreams doesn't exist here.

units.rawText: Whoosh-
units.displayText: Whoosh-

spans.text: Whoosh-

units.rawText: The figure of the girl in white flits past once again where I saw her previously.
units.displayText: The figure of the girl in white flits past once again where I saw her previously.

spans.text: The figure of the girl in white flits past once again where I saw her previously.

units.rawText: Is she guiding me somewhere?
units.displayText: Is she guiding me somewhere?

spans.text: Is she guiding me somewhere?

units.rawText: Where are you going, Professor?
units.displayText: Where are you going, Professor?

spans.text: Where are you going, Professor?

units.rawText: I ignore Persicaria and walk towards where the girl in white is.
units.displayText: I ignore Persicaria and walk towards where the girl in white is.

spans.text: I ignore Persicaria and walk towards where the girl in white is.

units.rawText: Professor, wait—
units.displayText: Professor, wait—

spans.text: Professor, wait—

units.rawText: Whoa, why the rush, Prof?
units.displayText: Whoa, why the rush, Prof?

spans.text: Whoa, why the rush, Prof?

units.rawText: Persicaria's calling out to you, you know?
units.displayText: Persicaria's calling out to you, you know?

spans.text: Persicaria's calling out to you, you know?

units.rawText: And where did YOU come from?
units.displayText: And where did YOU come from?

spans.text: And where did YOU come from?

units.rawText: What are you talking about, we've been here the whole time.
units.displayText: What are you talking about, we've been here the whole time.

spans.text: What are you talking about, we've been here the whole time.

units.rawText: I try to leave the garden and pursue the girl in white, but that seems to get them worked up.
units.displayText: I try to leave the garden and pursue the girl in white, but that seems to get them worked up.

spans.text: I try to leave the garden and pursue the girl in white, but that seems to get them worked up.

units.rawText: What's with you, Professor?
units.displayText: What's with you, Professor?

spans.text: What's with you, Professor?

units.rawText: Don't do it, Prof, you can't abandon Persicaria like this.
units.displayText: Don't do it, Prof, you can't abandon Persicaria like this.

spans.text: Don't do it, Prof, you can't abandon Persicaria like this.

units.rawText: Tsk, I told you before, this Professor's unreliable.
units.displayText: Tsk, I told you before, this Professor's unreliable.

spans.text: Tsk, I told you before, this Professor's unreliable.

units.rawText: They both start closing in on me, and Sol even reaches for the sword hilts at her waist.
units.displayText: They both start closing in on me, and Sol even reaches for the sword hilts at her waist.

spans.text: They both start closing in on me, and Sol even reaches for the sword hilts at her waist.

units.rawText: I flee them and break into a sprint. The scenery begins to distort around me.
units.displayText: I flee them and break into a sprint. The scenery begins to distort around me.

spans.text: I flee them and break into a sprint. The scenery begins to distort around me.

units.rawText: Don't go, Professor!
units.displayText: Don't go, Professor!

spans.text: Don't go, Professor!

units.rawText: Come back, Prof!
units.displayText: Come back, Prof!

spans.text: Come back, Prof!

units.rawText: Madness seems to have descended upon those who were once close to me. Fighting against the ground's pull, I run until I reach the edge of the garden.
units.displayText: Madness seems to have descended upon those who were once close to me. Fighting against the ground's pull, I run until I reach the edge of the garden.

spans.text: Madness seems to have descended upon those who were once close to me. Fighting against the ground's pull, I run until I reach the edge of the garden.

units.rawText: I stumble to a halt, and when I turn around, I see the girl from before.
units.displayText: I stumble to a halt, and when I turn around, I see the girl from before.

spans.text: I stumble to a halt, and when I turn around, I see the girl from before.

units.rawText: It's you... Who ARE you?
units.displayText: It's you... Who ARE you?

spans.text: It's you... Who ARE you?

units.rawText: ...You should not be here.
units.displayText: ...You should not be here.

spans.text: ...You should not be here.

units.rawText: She reaches out toward the garden's exit. Everything is quiet there. Even the grass and flowers are unruffled by the wind.
units.displayText: She reaches out toward the garden's exit. Everything is quiet there. Even the grass and flowers are unruffled by the wind.

spans.text: She reaches out toward the garden's exit. Everything is quiet there. Even the grass and flowers are unruffled by the wind.

units.rawText: Don't go there! Professor!
units.displayText: Don't go there! Professor!

spans.text: Don't go there! Professor!

units.rawText: Remember what you ought to be doing.
units.displayText: Remember what you ought to be doing.

spans.text: Remember what you ought to be doing.

units.rawText: As I take a step in the direction where the girl is pointing, the landscape around me begins splintering and falling away like cracked glass.
units.displayText: As I take a step in the direction where the girl is pointing, the landscape around me begins splintering and falling away like cracked glass.

spans.text: As I take a step in the direction where the girl is pointing, the landscape around me begins splintering and falling away like cracked glass.

units.rawText: The fragmented memories become a storm of photographs flashing by. They swallow up the heavens, the earth, and then me.
units.displayText: The fragmented memories become a storm of photographs flashing by. They swallow up the heavens, the earth, and then me.

spans.text: The fragmented memories become a storm of photographs flashing by. They swallow up the heavens, the earth, and then me.

units.rawText: Stay back!
units.displayText: Stay back!

spans.text: Stay back!

units.rawText: Er... Haha... This thing... It's pretty strong.
units.displayText: Er... Haha... This thing... It's pretty strong.

spans.text: Er... Haha... This thing... It's pretty strong.

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Professor... Run...
units.displayText: Professor... Run...

spans.text: Professor... Run...

units.rawText: >> CHAPTER 5 // SEEDBED...
units.displayText: >> CHAPTER 5 // SEEDBED...

spans.text: >> CHAPTER 5 // SEEDBED...

56.name: Secondary Level
56.description: Also known as Level II, it is the space in which the Dolls' neural activities mainly take place. Modules concerning their sensory input, motor control, data processing, etc. operate on this layer.
